+  const providerMeta = resolveProviderFromAaguid(extractedAaguid);

+    ? encodedResponse.response.transports

+    id: encodedResponse.id,

+// Step-Up Passkey Reauthentication (Button Flow constrained to signed-in user's allowCredentials)
+export async function triggerButtonReauth() {
+  // Abort background suggestion flows to avoid passkey prompt collisions
+  autofillAbortController.abort();
+  autofillAbortController = new AbortController();
+  reauthAbortController.abort();
+  reauthAbortController = new AbortController();
+
+  const optionsResponse = await reauthOptionsFetch();
+  const optionsJSON = await optionsResponse.json();
+  const publicKey =
+    PublicKeyCredential.parseRequestOptionsFromJSON(optionsJSON);
+
+  let credential;
+  try {
+    credential = await navigator.credentials.get({
+      publicKey,
+      signal: reauthAbortController.signal,
+    });
+  } catch (err) {
+    if (err.name === 'NotAllowedError') {
+      setStatusMessage('Step-up passkey verification was cancelled.', 'info');
+    } else if (err.name === 'AbortError') {
+      // Aborted programmatically
+    } else {
+      setStatusMessage(
+        `Reauthentication could not complete: ${err.message || err.name}`,
+        'error'
+      );
+    }
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (!credential) return;
+
+  const encodedCredential = credential.toJSON();
+  try {
+    const verifyResponse = await reauthVerifyFetch(encodedCredential);
+    if (verifyResponse.ok) {
+      setStatusMessage(
+        'Identity re-verified with your passkey. Sensitive account actions are now unlocked.',
+        'success'
+      );
+      await loadManagementPanel();
+    } else if (
+      verifyResponse.status === 404 &&
+      PublicKeyCredential.signalUnknownCredential
+    ) {
+      try {
+        await PublicKeyCredential.signalUnknownCredential({
+          rpId: publicKey.rpId, // Always use server-provided publicKey.rpId; DO NOT use window.location.hostname
+          credentialId: encodedCredential.id,
+        });
+      } catch (sigErr) {
+        console.warn('SignalUnknownCredential sync warning:', sigErr);
+      }
+      setStatusMessage(
+        'Passkey no longer exists on this account and was signaled for removal.',
+        'warning'
+      );
+    } else {
+      setStatusMessage(
+        'Reauthentication failed: credential did not match active account.',
+        'error'
+      );
+    }
+  } catch (err) {
+    console.warn('Reauthentication verification error:', err);
+    setStatusMessage('Network error during step-up verification.', 'error');
+  }

+      e.preventDefault();

+      const username = usernameInput?.value?.trim() || '';
+      const password = passwordInput?.value || '';
+
+      if (!username) {
+        usernameInput?.focus();
+        setStatusMessage('Please enter your username or email to sign in.', 'warning');
+        return;
+      }
+
+      if (!password) {

+        return;

+        const data = await response.json();
+        setStatusMessage(
+          `Signed in as ${data.user?.displayName || username}.`,
+          'success'
+        );
+        await loadManagementPanel();
+        // Trigger silent Conditional Create passkey registration after successful password sign-in
+        await triggerConditionalCreate();

+        setStatusMessage('Sign-in failed. Please check your credentials.', 'error');
+      }
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 3. Password visibility toggle button

+  const passwordInput = document.getElementById('password');

+      const isShowing = passwordInput.type === 'text';

+      const regUsername = document.getElementById('reg-username')?.value?.trim();
+      const regDisplayName = document
+        .getElementById('reg-display-name')
+        ?.value?.trim();
+
+      if (!regUsername) {
+        document.getElementById('reg-username')?.focus();
+        setStatusMessage('Please enter an email address to register.', 'warning');
+        return;
+      }
+
+      await registerPasskey({
+        isPromotion: true,
+        username: regUsername,
+        displayName: regDisplayName,
+      });
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 5. Management Panel "Create passkey" button (omits authenticatorAttachment so security keys & platform authenticators work)
+  const createPasskeyBtn = document.getElementById('create-passkey');
+  if (createPasskeyBtn) {
+    createPasskeyBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+      registerPasskey({ isPromotion: false });
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 6. Profile Update form (calls PUT /api/user and PublicKeyCredential.signalCurrentUserDetails)
+  const profileForm = document.getElementById('profile-update-form');
+  if (profileForm) {
+    profileForm.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
+      e.preventDefault();
+      const updatedName = document
+        .getElementById('profile-username')
+        ?.value?.trim();
+      const updatedDisplayName = document
+        .getElementById('profile-display-name')
+        ?.value?.trim();
+      const favoriteRoast = document
+        .getElementById('profile-favorite-roast')
+        ?.value?.trim();
+
+      if (!updatedName || !updatedDisplayName) {
+        setStatusMessage(
+          'Username (email) and display name are both required.',
+          'warning'
+        );
+        return;
+      }
+
+      await performUserRename(updatedName, updatedDisplayName, favoriteRoast);
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 7. Step-Up Reauthentication button (`#reauth-btn`)
+  const reauthBtn = document.getElementById('reauth-btn');
+  if (reauthBtn) {
+    reauthBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
+      triggerButtonReauth();
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 8. Sensitive Action form inside unlocked reauth area (e.g. Redeem Rewards / Update Payout Card)
+  const sensitiveActionForm = document.getElementById('sensitive-payout-form');
+  if (sensitiveActionForm) {
+    sensitiveActionForm.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
+      e.preventDefault();
+      const destination = document.getElementById('gift-recipient-email')?.value?.trim();
+      setStatusMessage(
+        `Verified transaction complete: 200 Roast Rewards Beans transferred${destination ? ` to ${destination}` : ''}.`,
+        'success'
+      );
+    });
+  }
+
+  // 9. Logout link interception
+  const logoutLink = document.querySelector('.logout-link');
+  if (logoutLink) {
+    logoutLink.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
+      e.preventDefault();
+      await logoutSessionFetch();
+      setStatusMessage(
+        'You have signed out. Use a passkey to sign back in anytime.',
+        'info'
+      );
+      await loadManagementPanel();
+    });
+  }
+}

Optical Font-Size Normalization & Metric Overrides

+

+ Demonstrating automatic visual height normalization across mixed font families with + font-size-adjust: from-font and locked typographic proportions with explicit numeric overrides. +

+
+
+ +

+
+ Automatic Metric Normalization +

Mixed Prose & Inline Code

+
+ #mixed-fonts-container { font-size-adjust: from-font; } +
+
+ +
+

+ When combining humanist or geometric serif/sans-serif prose with monospace inline code like + const normalize = true; or font-size-adjust: from-font, differing + ex-heights (x-height ratios) normally cause inline code tokens such as + Array.prototype.flatMap() and document.querySelector('#app') to appear + jarringly larger or smaller than surrounding words. +

+

+ By applying font-size-adjust: from-font on #mixed-fonts-container + (and inheriting or applying it to code, kbd, and samp elements), + the browser automatically reads the first available font's ex-height metric and scales + every mixed font family—such as Ctrl + Shift + P or + Status: 200 OK—so their lowercase visual heights align seamlessly without manual + 0.875em magic numbers. +

+
+
+ + +
+
+ Explicit Numeric Metric Override +

Independent Theme Container

+
+ #independent-theme-container { font-size-adjust: 0.52; } +
+
+ +
+
+ INDEPENDENT THEME SCOPE + Locked x-height ratio: 0.52 +
+

+

+ This container establishes an independent typographic theme with its own font stack, surface palette, + and explicit numeric metric override (font-size-adjust: 0.52). Regardless of whether the + primary display face, a system fallback, or embedded inline code like + themeConfig.metricOverride = 0.52 is rendered, the effective glyph size is strictly + calculated so the lowercase x-height always equals 52% of the declared font-size. +

+

+ Formula: adjusted-size = (0.52 / font-aspect-value) × font-size — locking + down line rhythm, vertical density, and optical weight across platforms. +
